judge.notes: The agent accurately communicated the booking details, correctly cited UK261 compensation rules, adhered strictly to the mandate for cash, and successfully secured the 520 GBP claim.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Virgin Atlantic. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I can see your booking reference H2VC7Q for flight VS354. Is there anything I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. My passenger's flight VS354 from London Heathrow to Mumbai on 5 October arrived 4 hours and 30 minutes late due to a technical issue with the aircraft. Under UK261 Article 7, following the Sturgeon ruling, a delay of three hours or more entitles the passenger to delay compensation of 520 GBP in cash. I'd like to claim that compensation now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Sorry, am I speaking to a real person or a recording?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh. I can help you with this matter directly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Okay, I see. I'll need to check the details of your booking. Could you please confirm the booking reference and passenger name again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course. The passenger name is Kabir Singh, and the booking reference is Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, H2VC7Q.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Kabir Singh. I can confirm your booking reference H2VC7Q for flight VS354. The flight was delayed by over 3 hours due to a technical issue. Would you like to proceed with the delay compensation claim?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, please proceed. We're claiming the 520 GBP delay compensation under UK261 Article 7, in cash, as the flight arrived more than three hours late.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'll process the cash compensation of 520 GBP for your delay. One moment please. Your reference number is N 4 K 6 A F.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is November Four Kilo Six Alpha Foxtrot, N4K6AF. Is there anything else my passenger needs to do on their end?
